guide.title: How to use Nibras
guide.subtitle: A quick, calm walkthrough of what Nibras can do.
guide.exploreSubtitle: Tap any icon below to see how it works.
guide.videoUnavailable: This explainer video is coming soon.
guide.libraryExplainerBody: The Library is where you keep your files and books. It works on this device now, with your data stored on your device. Signing in with an account to sync across your devices is coming soon.
guide.aiAssistantExplainerBody: The AI Assistant summarises your text and explains difficult words. It activates when AI is switched on.
guide.coloursStep1Body: You can change the background colour of every page in Nibras to whatever feels calm and easy on your eyes.
guide.coloursStep2Body: Tap the colours icon at the top of the page, pick a colour, and it is saved on your device until you change it.
guide.guideMascotStep1Body: On every page, the Nibras guide sits in the sidebar. Ask it, and it tells you how to use what is on the page. It stays silent until you ask.
guide.guideMascotStep2Body: The guide can read its help to you in a calm voice, and you can close it or open it again whenever you like.
guide.readerStep1Body: Paste any text, or open a whole PDF, EPUB, or text file. It's all read and processed on your device.
guide.readerStep2Body: Your text reflows instantly into the font, size, spacing, and background you've set. No extra steps.
guide.settingsStep1Body: Adjust font, text size, line spacing, and background tint until reading feels comfortable.
guide.settingsStep2Body: Saved on this device only, and applied automatically every time you come back.
guide.techniquesStep1Body: Short, evidence-based techniques for reading, comprehension, and focus, grouped into 3 categories.
guide.techniquesStep2Body: Every technique has its own read-aloud button, in English or Arabic.
guide.readingBuddyStep1Body: Press play over any text in the Reader and listen along as you read.
guide.readingBuddyStep2Body: Adjust the speed, and switch between two distinct voices, any time.
guide.mindMapsStep1Body: See a set of the techniques as one example map you can explore.
guide.mindMapsStep2Body: Add notes, rename ideas, add your own branches, and download it as an image.
guide.letterSoundsStep1Body: Tap any letter to hear the sound it makes and see it inside a simple word.
guide.letterSoundsStep2Body: Every letter is here, grouped so similar sounds sit together and are easier to learn.
guide.aiAssistantStep1Body: Get the gist of a text before you read it in full.
guide.aiAssistantStep2Body: Get a plain-language walkthrough of anything that isn't clear.
guide.libraryStep1Body: Open a file or paste text. It's saved to this device.
guide.libraryStep2Body: Group books into named, coloured folders, and pick any one back up where you left off.
guide.calmSpaceStep1Body: Find Calmness in the Reader's header, before or during reading.
guide.calmSpaceStep2Body: Follow a slow inhale-and-exhale rhythm. Pause any time; nothing here is saved.

mascot.name: Nibras guide
mascot.landingScript: Welcome to Nibras. It reformats text and reads it aloud to make reading more comfortable, in Arabic and English. Press Start to open the app, then pick any tool from your Dashboard.
mascot.play: Read the guide for this page
mascot.dashboardScript: This is your Dashboard. From here you can open the Reader, explore Reading Techniques, build Mind Maps, and see your recent activity. Tap any tool card to get started.
mascot.readerScript: This is the Reader. Paste or open any text, then use Reading settings to change the font, size, spacing, and colours until the page feels comfortable for you.
mascot.techniquesScript: These are short, evidence-based tips to help you read, focus, and understand more easily. They are sorted into three simple groups. Open any tip to read it, and press Listen to hear it aloud.
mascot.readingBuddyScript: Reading Buddy reads the text aloud in a calm voice, so you can listen as you read. Tap any word to hear it on its own. Read at your own pace, and nothing here is ever marked wrong.
mascot.mindMapsScript: A mind map turns ideas into a picture: one main idea in the middle, with its parts branching out around it. Explore the ready-made example, add your own notes and branches, and download it as an image. You can also change the map's background colour to whatever feels comfortable.
mascot.letterSoundsScript: Letter Sounds helps you learn the sound each letter makes. Tap any letter to hear its sound and see it inside a simple word. Every letter is here, in both Arabic and English, grouped so similar sounds sit together.
mascot.libraryScript: Your Library keeps your saved books and files together in one place. Open a file or paste text to add it, then pick it back up where you left off. Sort your books into coloured folders. Your books and files stay on your device.
mascot.profileScript: Your Profile brings your reading together in one place: your settings, your saved books, and your reading progress. It all stays private, on your device. Accounts to sync across your devices are coming soon.
mascot.guideScript: This is the Guide. Tap any feature icon to open a short explainer for it, usually a short video with optional captions. A couple of features show a short written explainer instead.
mascot.privacyScript: This is the Privacy page. It explains, in plain language, what Nibras does and does not do with your data, including that your reading and settings stay on your device. There is also a button near the top to listen to the whole policy read aloud.
mascot.signinScript: This is the Sign in page. Accounts are coming soon, so the sign-in buttons here are disabled for now. Nibras works on this device, privately, without needing an account.
